summary: Keep shell payload environments transient and scrub historical persisted values

replay.detail: Execution facts, outcomes, receipts, and native custody are preserved; no claim replay is required.

schema.detail: Store open adds a shell environment scrub completion marker, clears historical command environments, enables secure deletion, checkpoints the WAL, VACUUMs the database, and checkpoints again before marking completion.

rules.detail: Shell launch environments are held only in memory until consumed or the execution terminates. Stored and returned execution environments are empty. Never-launched commands without live context refuse with environment-unavailable; launched generations retain custody.

compatibility.detail: Public submission still accepts live environments. Pending commands cannot launch after daemon restart without resubmission. Do not downgrade to writers that persist shell environments.

downtime.detail: The first upgraded store open performs a database rewrite and fails closed on checkpoint contention or rewrite errors.

manual.detail: Stop competing database readers/writers if migration is busy, retry open, and resubmit pending commands whose launch context was lost. External backups and snapshots are outside the active-store scrub.

recovery.detail: Interrupted or failed scrubs repeat until physical rewrite and WAL truncation complete. Durable execution facts and existing generation custody remain readable.
